experiment: R101 ColBERT late-interaction (colbert-ir/colbertv2.0) full-corpus retrieval, fold-0, A100
verdict: STOP. Late interaction fails both zero-shot and fine-tuned: 3-5x worse than our existing retrievers, negligible unique recoveries (6/1600). Fold-0 filter; no 5-fold escalation.
mechanism: Late-interaction MaxSim helps on long span-rich documents; our track docs are ~24-39 tokens, too short for token-level matching to beat single-vector. The GT-vs-neighbor wall is a SIGNAL limitation (track text lacks distinguishing info for next-track), not a model-granularity problem (confirms R82).
implication: Retrieval lever now closed across ALL families+mechanisms (BGE/E5/GTE single-vector, cross-encoder rerank, ColBERT late-interaction). With ranking (R100) and response (R98) also closed, every nDCG lever is exhausted. R92 p11 (composite 0.6364) is the documented ceiling. Competitor nDCG 0.54-0.60 uses a method we cannot identify or reproduce.
